notes.title: 1.0: The Biggest Changes From Early Access
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey, Backpackers![/h2]

Some of you might be wondering: “so, what’s actually different between the 1.0 and Early Access version?”. Well, wonder no more - [b]here are the main features that came with Backpack Hero’s full release![/b]

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290630/13ecfac935f77108eead64b0bbf49a6640bdd2cf.png[/img] Meta progression[/h3]
Something many of you have been waiting for! No more throwing you in at the deep end - [b]your journey will begin with the basics[/b]. The game now guides you through the dungeons, gradually unlocking more and more possibilities to fight more and more powerful foes. [b]All the loot will have an impact on your future runs and the town’s development.[/b] Plan your actions well - [b]you can unlock new items using the ones you’ve already found.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290630/8ceb8c91993adcc5487b6096aba252f5c5f2173c.png[/img]

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290630/d8f9ef8445fd88e45f21b12689f012973c0ced75.png[/img] Story Mode[/h3]
Meta progression is strongly connected with yet another feature introduced in 1.0 - Story Mode. It comes with [b]a whole new gameplay experience that adds hours of fun![/b] You can [b]discover the lore[/b] and [b]meet new characters[/b] while [b]rebuilding the charming town of Haversack Hill.[/b] Taking things step by step, following the questline, and gradually unlocking new things will help you learn Backpack Hero’s basic mechanics - [b]it’s a great option for both players new to the roguelike world and seasoned backpackers looking to discover the stories behind the characters they know well![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290630/b5ece1dd058d9616a6339f9f92078ea448ece366.png[/img]

[h3]⚠️ We know that not everyone wants to jump into the Story Mode - [b]you can still find the classic gameplay with everything unlocked under the [i]Start Quick Game[/i] option![/b][/h3]

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290630/6017cf4980763a0aea8c470ea1deebd82464e414.png[/img] Achievements[/h3]
Achievement hunters can now begin their quest to complete them all! [b]Unlock 35 achievements[/b] - some of them you’ll unlock by simply playing the game, but some others require a lot of effort! We have ideas for many more, but that’s for later… 🤫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290630/84834012a756d098d0518e3b3e5587085113d33c.png[/img]

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290630/94d1930e70916a02524fa960c5758666145226a5.png[/img] If you haven’t played in a long while, or you’ve only tried the Demo, there’s even more new stuff![/h3] There are plenty of reasons to jump back into the game now! Try [b]all five characters[/b], each with [b]distinct gameplay mechanics.[/b] Create one-of-a-kind builds with [b]over 800 unique items[/b] that you can learn more about in [b]an improved atlas.[/b] Dive deep into the dungeons to fight [b]over 100 different foes.[/b] Enrich your experience with [b]incredible community-created mods.[/b] Enjoy Backpack Hero on [b]Steam Deck[/b] or [b]play comfortably with a controller![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290630/2f7feda1f86a772a281aa68a739486e4dcf58456.png[/img]

We hope you’re having lots of fun with all the new content! Let us know what your favorite parts are! 
Thanks for all the love, support and feedback you’re sharing ❤️

notes.title: Backpack Hero Mod Support and CR8 Update!

[b]Backpack Hero's official mod support is now live on the main branch of the game! 🎉[/b]

Simply select "Mods" from the Main Menu and you can add in tons of new items! 

One of my favorites is the mod from The Farlands Workshop!
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3023781444]You can easily add the mod to your game by subscribing to it on the Steam workshop[/url] 🔨[/b]

[list]
[*] Major changes to CR8! He has all new items, curses, relics, and an overheat mechanic that allows for some wicked new combos, but prevents some of the simpler infinites!
[*] CR8 "Gear" builds. These are like cleavers, but for our robot pal!
[*] The Cursed Forge! Add powerful new effects to your items at the cost of a permanent penalty applied to them! (Old forges are still there)
[*] Many new items including Pandora's Box!
[*] Buffed relics! More of the old relics will be added back in shortly!
[*] New sound effects and animated backgrounds!
[*] The Tusk doesn't effect CR8 components!
[*] Improved options and credits screen! Kickstarter supporters can find their names more easily!
[*] Many, many bug-fixes. We're sorry Coral wasn't working properly!
